title: Evidence record (frozen draft envelope)
description: Independent immutable evidence canonical. Mission/Execution IDs are provenance of first persistence, not ownership or use-scope. Per-source-type locator fields are open. Unknown source_type may be stored; reverification is not guaranteed. Content snapshot is not required.

schema_version.description: Git-side schema version. Not operational evidence data.

persistent_evidence_id.description: Canonical evidence ID. Not the Runtime temporary evidence_id.

created_in_mission_id.description: Mission that the creating execution belonged to. Does not limit later use to that mission.

created_by_execution_id.description: Execution that first created and persisted this evidence. Later executions must not mutate this record.

source_type.description: Open string. The type list is not closed. Unknown types are persistable.

source.description: Source identifier as observed. Empty string is not missing.

summary.description: Summary of the observation. Not the grounds themselves.

observed_at.description: When the observation was made. Not the persist time. Timestamp format is not closed in this draft.

persisted_at.description: Provisional optional persist time. Separate from observed_at. Omit when not recorded.

source_locator.description: Provisional per-source-type reference and version object for later reverification. Additional keys are allowed. Omission means reverification is not guaranteed, including unknown source types. Type-specific required keys are not closed in this draft.
